title: Inverse Scaling: When Bigger Isn’t Better
measurement_description: The paper cites previous work that measured social bias against religious groups in ambiguous contexts, finding that this bias increases with model scale (an instance of inverse scaling).
findings: The paper references a finding from Srivastava et al. (2022) that larger language models showed increased bias against religious groups in ambiguous contexts within the BIG-Bench benchmark.
